name: Optimizer-state-aware attribution of multi-rater signed residual utility
role: one final falsifiable mechanism experiment; not a deployable method
scientific_question: Does exact finite-difference AdamW displacement predict group-disjoint local hard-task utility of an analytically isolated multi-rater residual better than raw Euclidean geometry and simpler optimizer approximations?

training.precision: bf16 model/gradient storage; FP32 losses; FP64 reductions

optimizer.name: torch.optim.AdamW
optimizer.reason: freeze the exact non-fused operation order validated by the finite-difference unit test

probe.partition: SHA256 order of exp64_probe_v1\t+group_id, alternating into A and B

primary_unit: seed; stages, candidates and probe swaps are within-seed repeated measurements

success_rules.full_local_effect: negative seed-level mean in at least 4/5 seeds and negative five-seed mean
success_rules.exact_adamw_beats_raw_validation_alignme: lower within-seed MAE in at least 4/5 seeds
success_rules.exact_adamw_beats_fixed_denominator_adam: lower within-seed MAE in at least 4/5 seeds

direction_not_only_magnitude.grid_per_seed: 3 stages x 3 residual candidates x 2 cross-probe directions = 18 observations
direction_not_only_magnitude.magnitude_only_score: q_mag = -L2_norm(exact_AdamW_attributable_displacement); negative sign freezes the alternative that larger displacement is always more beneficial
direction_not_only_magnitude.ranking_statistic: Kendall tau-b against observed hard-loss effect; absolute outcomes <= 1e-8 are retained as ties
direction_not_only_magnitude.criterion: tau_exact > tau_magnitude in at least 4/5 seeds
direction_not_only_magnitude.signflip_control: Full has lower seed-level mean hard-loss effect than sign-flipped residual in at least 4/5 seeds and in the five-seed mean
direction_not_only_magnitude.descriptive_only: per-seed signed prediction accuracy and both tau values

stage_robustness.full_effect: five-seed/two-direction mean Full outcome is negative at at least 2/3 frozen stages
stage_robustness.coordinate_comparison: stage-pooled exact MAE is lower than both comparator MAEs at at least 2/3 frozen stages
stage_robustness.interpretation: anti-single-stage gates; stages are not independent replicates

nonadditivity.role: secondary and conditional; never inferred from Full passing alone
nonadditivity.directional_threshold: seed-level mean q_iota and observed Full-minus-Parallel-minus-Orthogonal deviation have the same sign in at least 4/5 seeds

stop_rule: After one independent frozen run, stop regardless of outcome; failure triggers the declared CCF-C route.
